purpose: Test one independent-information hypothesis: monthly primary-share demand in the six original leveraged ETFs may improve the timing of a fixed monthly new-money deposit. One monthly SSI feature, one joint portfolio model, and one fixed buy-now-or-five-common-sessions-later policy. No search over SSI definitions, component subsets, signs, thresholds or horizons.
targetPreference: User priority is monthly new money versus fixed-date investing. One-year holding and a five-common-session maximum wait remain unconfirmed research assumptions; three years is auxiliary. Do not claim suitability for other horizons or select one after outcomes.
priorExposure: The full portfolio history has been inspected in the withdrawn trend/similarity scores, seven v1 waiting rules, v2, the scope audit, v3, v4, and the hindsight opportunity diagnostic. This is a fifth historically exposed candidate, not an untouched holdout. All failures and source hashes remain preserved. No correction for the entire adaptive research search is claimed.

independentMotivation.evidence: Davies Table5 reports an in-sample relation of previous-month SSI to the next month first five trading days of broad-US-index returns. It supplies a mechanism to test, not an out-of-sample five-day strategy or a result for USD/TQQQ/CNY.
independentMotivation.windowMismatch: The paper uses month-end to the next month fifth trading day. This study measures the first common funding close to its fifth subsequent common close (normally the sixth monthly common close). Nominal10/20 transfers the month-first training target to later dates; it is not the paper window.
independentMotivation.annualTarget: Annual terminal-value labels directly target equal-age one-year contribution wealth. Future annual terminal prices reweight the five-session unit difference and add noise. This is not pure five-day return prediction and does not exactly match twelve-deposit common-end accounts.
independentMotivation.dataReconciliation: Current official ProShares reconstruction is highly correlated but not identical to the author legacy standardized series. The paper primarily used Bloomberg shares. Neither retrospective affine calibration nor AUM/NAV implied shares is used as the candidate input.

inheritance: Recursively verify v3 and its dependencies. Inherit original source prices/FX/common calendar, portfolio, cash and fees, funding schedules, endpoints, partitions, exclusions, account NAV and paired accounting, all benchmarks and gates. Replace only price features/daily training pool/756 threshold with the explicit single monthly SSI and 36-month pool below. Do not inherit the 200-price-day feature warmup or alter old files. v4 is preserved as prior evidence and supplies clarified gates, not component actions for this candidate.

sourceSnapshot.rule: Use exactly the hash-bound v3 actual per-product CNY price rows and common calendar, unchanged FX mapping and maximum age. Do not extend product history or forward-fill trade prices. The only added feature information is the six hash-bound official monthly share histories described in this protocol.

ssiSource.definition: For each of SSO,QLD,DDM,SDS,QID,DXD take the last actual record in each completed calendar month. Growth is displayed Shares Outstanding (000) in month m divided by that in previous calendar month m-1, minus one. SSI_m is the sum for SSO,QLD,DDM minus the sum for SDS,QID,DXD. Raw fractional growth sum; no division by three or leverage multiplier.
ssiSource.calendar: Require consecutive calendar months and finite positive shares for all six funds at both endpoints. Retain all six source dates. The archived audit found each fund month-end equal to the common month-end. If not equal in future inputs, treat that SSI month as unavailable rather than silently using an earlier common date or mixing asynchronous month endpoints.
ssiSource.adjustment: Use displayed official histories as printed. No additional split adjustment, AUM/NAV substitution, winsorization, interpolation, author-value imputation or date-shift search. Preserve the 3 strict NAV printed-precision exceptions and original source differences, without post-result tolerance changes.
ssiSource.vintage: This is a fixed current-version historical reconstruction, not verified original historical releases. Exact future common rescaling cancels in growth, quantization and substantive revisions may not. Source hashes bind this experiment only.
ssiSource.featureMonth: At funding t use exactly the previous completed calendar month, never the current incomplete month or an older available substitute. A source observation from that previous month is not asserted known at its closing instant.

availability.decisionClock: One hour before the scheduled US equity market close on the actual common funding session, including early-close sessions. This is a declared decision/execution convention, not a timestamp observed in historical source files. Execution remains that session closing price under inherited research costs.
availability.baseAssumption: The completed six-fund month-end input is available by the decision cutoff of the first subsequent common portfolio session. Preserve source record dates; never backdate to economic creation/settlement times. This assumption applies to both historical training features and evaluated decisions.
availability.limit: Daily public dissemination has official support, but row-specific original CSV publication clocks, historical revisions and whole-history adjustment definitions are not established. NAV calculation time, AP T+6 creation and HTTP Last-Modified are not first-publication timestamps.
availability.priceAndLabelCutoff: Only portfolio prices and annual outcomes through the previous actual common close can enter a fit. H(s)=t is not mature at the pre-close decision and is excluded. The monthly share feature may have been published overnight before t and is recorded separately from that price cutoff.
availability.fallback: For a fit-ready decision, if the required latest completed-month SSI is absent, mismatched, nonfinite, or not available by cutoff, invest immediately as the benchmark. Record null forecast, offset0, explicit reason and coverage. Never use an older SSI or remove this month from results. This is distinct from insufficient-training warmup.

extraSessionDiagnostic.rule: Replay the already fixed base decision stream with input arrival delayed one extra common session; cancel a decision whose required SSI has not arrived and use immediate investment. Keep base mature fits unchanged; this is a runtime-arrival cancellation sensitivity, not a separately refitted alternative training-vintage model or a second candidate.
extraSessionDiagnostic.knownBeforeResults: Nominal1 arrivals are the first common sessions of their months, so every otherwise eligible primary decision is cancelled and primary incremental wealth is exactly zero by construction. This exposes dependence on next-session availability; it cannot be described as positive robustness or independent strategy confirmation.
extraSessionDiagnostic.reporting: Report cancellation coverage and paired outcomes on the same base-qualified accounts across all original cells. Do not use this diagnostic to select a publication lag, rescue a failed main case, change fee/cash gates, or call an unsupported publication assumption verified. Distinguish unique fit-ready arrival months whose required input is delayed from actual cancellation of a base offset5 order; an original offset0 decision is not a cancelled delayed purchase.

model.trainingCalendar: Use the unchanged nominal1 funding calendar on the fixed 4206 common-price rows. Generate at most one training event for each calendar month, at its first actual common funding close. Exclude entryIndex0 (2010-02-11), which has no previous common close. Do not require 200 price observations. No daily duplication of the monthly feature; no nominal10/20 entries in training.
model.labelEnd: H(s) is the first actual common close on or after the one-calendar-year anniversary of original funding s, at most 14 calendar days later, with February29 clamped to February28. Require s+5<=H(s). Unobserved outcomes do not form labels. The SSI feature at s must satisfy the fixed base availability/validity definition for that entry. The SSI validity/availability condition applies to training labels only. Evaluation-only annual wealth-difference labels require complete price endpoints but not current SSI availability, so fallback months and fixed-delay benchmark identities remain in the accounting audit.
model.label: y_s = (1-0.001)/(1+0.001) * sum_j [originalWeight_j * CNY_price_j(H(s)) * (1/CNY_price_j(s+5) - 1/CNY_price_j(s))]. Original weights are 0.3 and 0.3, not normalized 0.5/0.5. This is delayed-minus-immediate one-year net terminal wealth divided by the whole deposit. Identical strategic cash cancels in the zero-interest base scenario.
model.labelUnits: Fraction of the full original deposit. 100*y is the terminal difference in percentage points of total funding; 10000*y is basis points of the full deposit, not of the product budget.
model.pool: Sort eligible nominal1 training events by (exitIndex,entryIndex). For a decision t include exactly events with exitIndex<t. Insert each once, including all events sharing an endpoint. Require at least36 distinct mature monthly entries; 36 overlapping annual labels are not36 independent years.
model.calendarTransfer: One expanding algorithm and one nominal1 target pool serve every decision date. At nominal10/20 (or another historical query t), update that same pool to t-1; do not create a separate training pool, tuning or per-calendar model. This is not freezing the month-first fitted coefficients through the whole month. Each decision records its actual mature prefix and may legitimately differ after new monthly labels mature.
model.fit: Use mean squared error plus1*beta^2. Fit the mean and population standard deviation of the single SSI feature from exactly the mature monthly pool; map zero SD to zero. Center y, leave intercept unpenalized. Prediction is meanY+beta*standardizedCurrentSsi. No clipping, sign constraint/reversal, calibration from author outputs, rolling-window search or hyperparameter selection.
model.closedFormCheck: For nonzero feature SD, beta=mean(z*(y-meanY))/(1+1). With zero SD beta=0 and forecast=meanY. The general one-dimensional ridge solver must match this independent identity.
model.policy: On each deposit C reserve0.4*C strategic CNY cash and0.3*C for each product including buy fees. If a valid available prediction exceeds1e-12 full-deposit fraction, wait exactly5 common sessions for both legs; otherwise buy both immediately. Same action covers the whole60% investment budget. No borrowing, selling, different leg actions, additional deposits, budget changes, interim re-prediction, early release or longer wait.
model.stress: Freeze base decisions for inherited cash2 and fee20; recompute actual cash interest and fees. Publication cancellation is the separate predeclared sensitivity above, never a replacement for economic cost stress.

accounting: Inherit exactly the v3 equal-budget 30% USD/30% TQQQ/40% strategic CNY cash account with original product adjusted prices, FX and costs. For base equal-age one-year lots, candidate-minus-immediate terminal wealth/C equals label y if offset5, otherwise0, including documented missing-input fallback. Do not apply original target weights to drifting market values after purchase. Risk is the new-money account, not the user entire pre-existing portfolio.

evaluation.primary: Nominal day 1, equal_age_lot, holdingYears=1. Each unique monthly deposit has one common one-year endpoint and one pair of outcomes. Include unchanged/immediate decisions as exact zero improvement; do not discard them from the unconditional result.
evaluation.calendarMeaning: Cash is available only at the designated calendar day's first actual common close in that same month, as in the scope audit. This is a hypothetical funding schedule, not a claim about the user's payday.
evaluation.warmup: Require at least 36 eligible mature nominal-1 monthly labels and a valid finite one-feature fit. Exclude the entire paired account if any arrival is still in model warmup or has an invalid fit; use identical paired eligibility for all benchmarks. Once fit-ready, a missing or not-yet-available required SSI month produces a documented immediate-investment fallback, retained as zero delta rather than removing that month.
evaluation.allResults: Report all 108 calendar/scope/horizon/partition/scenario cells, including empty cells and full exclusion reasons. No new winner selection among dates or horizons.
evaluation.accountScope: The twelve-deposit account is an additional necessary non-inferiority check, not the same estimand as each lot held one year. Three-year accounts are auxiliary; short samples and missing outcomes cannot be substituted or stretched to obtain confirmation.
evaluation.predictionDiagnostics: On unique eligible primary monthly arrivals with an available feature, report annual-label MAE/MSE and the forecast using the mean of exactly the same mature monthly training pool. Separate unavailable-feature fallback counts; do not give them fabricated predictions. These diagnostics do not substitute for realized money outcomes.

selectionAndConfirmation.candidateSelection: None: exactly one fixed candidate. Development primary/base must satisfy all economic, action-coverage and concentration gates below before either later partition can confirm. A development failure makes later outputs diagnostic only. Never replace it with a better date, horizon, threshold or variant.
selectionAndConfirmation.actionDefinitions: Action means this deposit was actually delayed five sessions. Count unique arrival dates, not rolling-account occurrences. For non-overlap, sort delayed lots by arrival date and greedily keep a lot only when its arrival is strictly after the prior kept lot's terminal. These minimum counts are evidence screens, not a claim of independent observations or guaranteed statistical power.
selectionAndConfirmation.concentration: For each primary partition, delete each represented funding calendar year in turn and require the remaining unconditional mean delta to be strictly positive. Also enumerate every calendar-month start m from the earliest eligible month through the latest eligible month minus 11 months, and remove all arrivals in [m,m+12 calendar months). Do not skip a block because of an internal missing month or select blocks after seeing returns. Every remaining unconditional mean must be strictly positive. Require at least 24 eligible months and at least one full block. Preserve zeros, dates and removed/remaining counts. These diagnostics reduce single-period dependence but do not prove independent market regimes. For every deletion, remove the whole monthly deposit including both component actions and outcomes together. At least one fully observed block means all12 calendar months in that block have eligible arrivals; incomplete blocks are still enumerated and must also pass, never filtered from the positivity requirement.
selectionAndConfirmation.laterPartitions: Both validation (2019-2022 full outcomes) and replication (2023 onward full outcomes) must separately satisfy all the same economic/action/concentration gates. The primary/base 12-month-block descriptive mean interval must have status descriptive and lower>0 in each. Keep the original 2000 draws, Mulberry32 seed 0x6d2b79f5 and 2.5/97.5 percentiles; no insufficient/empty interval passes.
selectionAndConfirmation.benchmarks: In each later primary/base partition, paired mean and median against fixed_delay5 and three_tranches must both be >=0 on identical qualified accounts.
selectionAndConfirmation.stress: In each later primary partition, cash2 and fee20 must each retain strictly positive unconditional mean delta versus immediate, nonnegative median, and the same risk lower bounds. Action dates stay fixed.
selectionAndConfirmation.calendarTransfer: In each later partition, nominal 10 and 20 equal-age one-year base results must each have nonnegative mean and median delta versus their own immediate benchmark. These are necessary transferability checks, never alternative primary winners or proof for every possible payday.
selectionAndConfirmation.completeMonthlyAccount: In each later partition, nominal 1 twelve-deposit/hold-one-year base accounts must each have nonnegative mean and median delta versus immediate, plus the same risk lower bounds. Report 24-month-block intervals and sample limits; do not claim those limited windows alone establish long-run monthly-account superiority.
selectionAndConfirmation.precision: Every numeric gate requires a finite value; null, undefined, nonfinite and empty/insufficient evidence fail, including nonnegative transfer/account checks. Counts are exact nonnegative integers, action share thresholds are fractions in [0,1] with no monetary tolerance. Monetary and risk gates operate on unrounded percentage-point values; >= gates allow only 1e-10 absolute floating-rounding tolerance. Strict positivity for wins, concentration, stress means and interval lower bounds means >1e-10 percentage points. Action threshold remains the fixed 1e-12 deposit fraction.
selectionAndConfirmation.whyNewGates: No new numeric economic, action, risk or confirmation gate. Inherit v3, including the explicit complete-block and empty/finite/count clarifications recorded in v4. Old v1-v4 failures remain failed; do not reinterpret them with this study.
selectionAndConfirmation.integration: Historical confirmation alone does not publish a score. Require an independent annual-label/model/ledger/causality audit, production-equivalent fee/dividend/personal-tax validation, precise validated portfolio/funding/holding scope and future recomputation behavior. Do not transform an unvalidated forecast into a 0-100 score or automatically integrate it. In addition, a result remains conditional on the current-vintage ProShares reconstruction and next-session-before-cutoff availability assumption. Author-series correlation is not predictive validation. Independently audit input provenance and actual future arrival handling; no score while those production requirements are unresolved.

decisionTrace.labels: Separate nominal1 trainingLabels from evaluation-only labels needed for 1/10/20 annual accounting checks and diagnostics. Evaluation labels never enter the fit. Current prediction availability does not require its own future annual label.
decisionTrace.fitAndInputStatus: Distinguish model warmup/invalid fit from valid fit with missing current input. Fallback decisions are auditable offset0 with null prediction, not fabricated good scores.
decisionTrace.stateMachine: Warmup or invalid fit: fitReady=false, actionAvailable=false, candidate and every benchmark exclude that paired account. Valid fit and unavailable current input: fitReady=true, inputAvailable=false, actionAvailable=true, forecast=null, offset0, explicit fallback retained. Valid fit and input: all true, finite forecast and locked0/5 offset. No null forecast is silently treated as a numeric zero.

auditRequirements: Verify every frozen dependency and raw source hash and retain existing failures unchanged.
Independently reconstruct consecutive-month six-fund displayed-share growth, signs/units, input dates and the declared availability cut, including missing/month mismatch and no older-month fallback.

Independently reconstruct unique monthly annual labels, exact anniversary maturity, per-date mature prefixes, population standardization and one-dimensional ridge/closed-form fits. Do not count daily repeated SSI as extra training evidence.

At all required 1/10/20 decisions check that only nominal1 labels enter training, every exit is <=previous close, and no current/future price or uncompleted/future SSI month changes a previous decision when mutated or appended.
Independently reconstruct actual fees, units, cash, annual label/account identities, all paired cells and original numeric gates. Report complete and partial ledger coverage honestly.
Verify publication-plus-one cancellation sensitivity remains descriptive and primary zero-by-construction; never mark it a positive robustness pass.
No historical result alone creates a 0-100 score; preserve input timing/current-vintage, production fee/dividend/personal-tax, precise user scope and future recomputation requirements.
stoppingRule: One predeclared candidate only. Preserve all original gates and every failure. Do not choose a data field, source month, lag, fund subset, sign, threshold, lambda, sample length, entry date or holding horizon after results. Any later materially distinct proposal requires its own independent rationale and advance review; no automatic successor tuning.

preOutcomeCalendarAudit.basis: Dates and archived monthly input completeness only. No new annual label values, fitted coefficients, predictions or investment outcomes were computed. Counts assume a finite fit once the 36-month pool is available; later numerical failures must be reported, never repaired by altering scope.
preOutcomeCalendarAudit.limitations: 36 monthly labels have overlapping annual outcomes. Newly earlier model readiness changes coverage relative to v3/v4; do not call extra months an untouched sample. Full outcomes still determine evaluation eligibility, never the availability of current predictions.

reviewState: Root, independent protocol reviewer and implementation reviewer completed review before any v5 label values, fitted predictions or candidate returns. Only source-input arithmetic and calendar/completeness/maturity counts have been inspected. Commit and push this protocol before implementing or running the real-data candidate; preserve the frozen definition and all prior failures.
